title: Parapet with cap
notes: Flat-roof parapet: one parapet block topped by a bottom-slab coping (architecture 8: flat parapet by default; Summerlin default: the roof-edge line may become coping, BUILDING-STANDARDS 8; slab line, Detail pp.20-21). Never raises the measured top: the compiler places it inside the accepted height. Cell "props" are merged into the palette block only where that block has the property (format note in COMPONENTS.md).
